call.x: Resilience Roadmaps Opportunity 25/11/2026 17.00 - CET 27/01/2027 17.00 - CET Creativity EIT Culture & Creativity has announced €1.275 million in funding for Resilience Roadmaps to support ten projects that will translate Europe’s environmental and societal transitions into lasting local change. The ten projects will bring cultural organisations, communities and public authorities together to tackle challenges affecting people and places across Europe. HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
